name: specular-band
title: Specular Band
description: Animated specular band effect with lens distortion and hue-shifted color palettes. Creates flowing, organic light bands with adaptive blending for different background brightness levels.

usage.label: Astro
React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-blocks/specular-band-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-specular-band
    color="#FF6900"
    background-color="#17181A"
    :speed="1.0"
    :distortion="0.2"
    :hue-shift="30"
    :intensity="1.0"
    class="w-full h-[500px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-blocks/specular-band-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-specular-band

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-blocks/specular-band-element.js"></script>

<motion-specular-band
  color="#FF6900"
  background-color="#17181A"
  speed="1.0"
  distortion="0.2"
  hue-shift="30"
  intensity="1.0"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: color
props.description: Base color of the specular bands.

props.name: hue-shift
props.description: Amount of hue shift for secondary bands (in degrees).
